One work, more than one way in

A circle of changes.

木→火→土→金→水↶

A moon jar can speak of earth when you follow its rounded form, and fire when you imagine its making. A golden screen can lead you through branches or through light. Try meeting the same work from another side.

This gallery takes inspiration from 五行 (wǔxíng), the five phases of Chinese thought: wood, fire, earth, metal and water. The tradition attends to change and relationships; our rooms follow its generating cycle.

The connections between these artworks are Artbitrage’s invitations to look. Each work keeps its own history, materials and museum record.

A note on 五行 and these pairings +

“Five phases” is one translation of 五行. Wood, fire, earth, metal and water are understood through their interactions. Here they offer a route across artworks made in different places and traditions.

Our pairings do not claim that the artists used this framework. A painted reflection belongs here through what we see; a bronze sculpture also belongs through what it is made from.
